## ef7a83e008ab

**Status: reproduced teaching defect.** Generator SHA-256 `e50a0f89889742d046cfb286c9681646479ffcdcfc35cda243d737b553a36b1c`; executed canonical rule hash `96b85edd5326`.

With seed `0`, difficulty `medium`, and consecutive sample indices `9,10,11,12`, all four generated inputs pass the target's `self_check`. The first three contain only red target components; their red/all-foreground component counts are `6/6`, `3/3`, and `6/6`. The query contains five red components plus one color-3 distractor, so the plausible rival **count every foreground component** fits every demonstration but predicts an alternating row of length 6 instead of the official length 5.

The canonical Racket outputs were obtained with:

```text
cwd: packet_root
python3 review.py run python3 -m arcpuzzles apply ef7a83e008ab --input ../checks/audit/ef7a83e008ab/input.json --out ../checks/audit/ef7a83e008ab/racket.json
```

Evidence:

- `checks/audit/ef7a83e008ab/counterexample.json` — complete four-pair lesson, validator results, official/rival outputs, hashes, and source identity; SHA-256 `269dbc0adf17e874c0fbeadaa7d1e3a90e835fad0d0907e101880cc55617b5f6`.
- `checks/audit/ef7a83e008ab/racket.json` — supported Racket apply receipt.
- `checks/audit/ef7a83e008ab/probe.json` — target/all-foreground component counts and distractor colors.
- `checks/audit-pre/ef7a83e008ab-lint/checks/ef7a83e008ab_before_lint.log` — secondary static issues: missing `RULE_HASH`, two top-level `self_check` definitions, and unprobed singleton axes.

**Scope.** This proves one reachable ordered lesson defect, not frequency. Suggested repair: guarantee at least one lawful distractor-bearing demonstration in every complete lesson, declare the count-all-foreground competitor, and test all schedule starts and query rotations.

## ef7a83e008ab

**Status: reproduced teaching defect on the current selected bytes.** Generator
SHA-256 `e50a0f89889742d046cfb286c9681646479ffcdcfc35cda243d737b553a36b1c`;
executed canonical rule hash `96b85edd5326`.

At seed `0`, difficulty `medium`, and consecutive sample indices `9,10,11,12`,
all four inputs pass `self_check`. The three demonstrations contain no
non-red foreground component, so the plausible rival **count every foreground
component** predicts the same alternating bars as the canonical rule (lengths
6, 3, and 6). The query contains five red components plus one isolated color-3
distractor; the canonical Racket output has length 5 while the rival predicts
length 6. Thus individually correct labels form an ambiguous ordered lesson.

Evidence: `checks/audit/ef7a83e008ab/counterexample.json`, `input.json`,
`probe.json`, and `racket.json`. The supported `arcpuzzles apply` receipt binds
the exact generator and rule hashes. The strict audit preset also fails because
this target declares no executable semantic contract and has no selected task
tests: `checks/audit/ef7a83e008ab/combined/result.json`.

Recommended repair: declare the foreground-count rival and require at least one
distractor-bearing demonstration whenever a distractor-bearing query is possible,
using a replayable lesson schedule rather than only increasing random probability.
